node.doctext: use strict; use warnings; use Data::Dumper; my %hosts; while (chomp(my $line = )) { my ($key,$val) = split /\s+/, $line, 2; $hosts{$key} = $val; } print Dumper \%hosts; __DATA__ XYZ1ADAIQ1 #AMI XYZ1ADECQ1 #OAG XYZ1ADEDQ1 XYZ1ADEDQ2 ##DMS Host
